items.name: Wrightsville Beach Sloop Printed Tea Towel
items.alt: Teal and navy sloop pattern tea towel hanging in a bright coastal kitchen, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed polyester tea towel with a navy all-over pattern of small sailboats on teal waves. A Wrightsville Beach kitchen gift made for the Carolina coast and Wilmington NC.
facts: Navy sloop pattern on teal waves, printed not embroidered
